text.p: Finnish paperboard maker Stromsdal Oy said on Friday it expected to report a small full-year 1996 profit.
"The company's earnings for the 1996 financial year are expected to be slightly positive," Stromsdal said in its January-August interim report.

"The general outlook for the paper- and paperboard markets is still unclear. Because of that, no big increases are expected in pulp prices, for example," the company said, adding it did not expect any major changes in the paperboard markets during ther end of the year.
In 1995, Stromsdal's profit before extraordinaries and tax was 0.3 million markka.

In January-August, its profit before extraordinaries and tax rose 71 percent to 2.6 million markka and earnings per share shot up to 1.9 markka from 1.0 markka while net sales fell 2.5 percent to 149.2 million markka.
